title: KnightForge Gambit Academy — 40 Repertoires
source_note: Move sequences supplied by the user and replayed from the standard starting position with python-chess. Only legally replayable lines are published as playable branches. Names and classifications are retained from the supplied curriculum; some entries are attacks, counterattacks or trap systems rather than strict pawn gambits.

sets.name: Queen's Gambit
sets.summary: White offers the c-pawn to build a strong centre and gain development if Black accepts.
sets.white_plan: Build a d4-e4 centre, develop rapidly, and use the open c-file if the c-pawn is accepted.
sets.black_plan: Challenge White's centre with ...c5 or ...e5; develop smoothly and avoid clinging to the pawn.
sets.finish_plan: Convert the central space advantage into active pieces, pressure on the c-file, and a favourable endgame.
key_ideas: Central break: e4 or cxd5 depending on Black's setup
Develop before trying to recover the pawn
common_traps: Do not assume the gambit pawn must be recovered immediately
Watch ...Bb4 pins and ...e5 central counterplay

sets.name: King's Gambit
sets.summary: White offers the f-pawn to open the f-file and accelerate kingside development.
sets.white_plan: Develop with Nf3, Bc4 or Bb5, castle quickly, and attack before Black consolidates.
sets.black_plan: If accepting, use ...g5 or ...d5 accurately; if declining, strike the centre and complete development.
sets.finish_plan: Use the open f-file and piece activity to build an attack; if queens come off, convert the lead in development into a sound position.
key_ideas: King safety is more important than grabbing pawns
Open lines: f-file and diagonals toward f7
Know the accepted and declined move orders
common_traps: Do not castle automatically if the centre is opening against your king
After ...g5, calculate ...g4 before moving the f3-knight

sets.name: Evans Gambit
sets.summary: White offers the b-pawn to gain tempi against the bishop and establish a powerful centre.
sets.white_plan: Play c3 and d4, develop with tempo, and castle before Black untangles.
sets.black_plan: Return material if needed, develop the queenside, and strike the centre with ...d6 or ...d5.
sets.finish_plan: Use the central pawn mass and lead in development to create threats against the king; transition to an active rook ending if the attack fades.
key_ideas: Build the d4-e5 centre when possible
Do not let development advantage disappear
common_traps: Do not grab extra material before castling
Watch ...d5 counterstrikes

sets.name: Vienna Gambit
sets.summary: White uses f4 to challenge e5 and create open attacking lines from a flexible Vienna move order.
sets.white_plan: Choose e5 or fxe5 according to Black's central reply; develop quickly and keep the king safe.
sets.black_plan: Use ...d5 or ...exf4 at the right moment, then develop and contest the centre.
sets.finish_plan: Convert initiative into a kingside attack or a favourable central endgame; avoid speculative pawn pushes after Black has consolidated.
key_ideas: The e5 advance can gain space but also create weaknesses
Know when to trade on e5
common_traps: Do not push e5 without checking ...Qe7 and ...Ng8 ideas
Calculate the ...d5 counterstrike before accepting a pawn

sets.black_plan: Black should challenge the bishop and centre with ...Bc5, ...Nf6 or timely ...d5.
sets.finish_plan: Use the open centre to activate rooks; if the attack ends, retain central control and avoid hanging pieces.
key_ideas: The e5 thrust can dislodge a knight

sets.name: Hennig-Schara Gambit
sets.summary: Black sacrifices a central pawn in the Tarrasch structure to open lines and gain active piece play.
sets.white_plan: White should calculate Qxd4 and Qa4+ carefully and avoid falling behind in development.
sets.black_plan: Use ...Nc6 and ...Bd7 to gain tempi on the queen and create central pressure.
sets.finish_plan: Use piece activity and open files to compensate for the pawn; if queens trade, seek active rook placement and targets.
common_traps: Do not rush to win back the pawn with the queen

sets.name: Winawer Countergambit (vs. Slav)
sets.summary: Black challenges the Slav structure with ...e5 and seeks to gain space after White captures.
sets.white_plan: White should decide between taking on e5 or maintaining the centre with e3 or Nf3.
sets.black_plan: Use ...d4 to gain space and open lines for the queen and bishops.
sets.finish_plan: Use the advanced d-pawn and active queen to generate pressure; if White blocks the centre, regroup and target the queenside.
common_traps: Do not allow White to develop with tempo on the queen
